## Summary

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api's latest deploy (v2.3.1) was unhealthy in all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent release healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back to v2.3.0**: The first rollback attempt hit an orchestrator error and only completed us-east. A retry succeeded, and all regions are now on v2.3.0 — **healthy, error rate back down to 0.2%**.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** documenting the health check failures and the rollback (the create call initially timed out, but I verified via `list_incidents` that the incident was successfully created — no duplicate was filed).

No change-manager approval was needed since v2.3.0 was previously healthy in production. The on-call engineer has been paged via the incident.
